title: Key Lime Bars
changes_from_base: A tangy lime and condensed-milk filling baked on a biscuit base, optionally topped with toasted coconut; replaces caramel and chocolate. Kept chilled.
summary: A lime and condensed-milk filling baked on a biscuit base and topped with toasted coconut.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly
full-fat cream cheese, at room temperature
fine sea salt or table salt
fresh lime juice (key or regular limes)

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Heat the oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan) and line the 20 cm tin with a sling. Blitz the biscuits to fine crumbs, pulse in the sugar and salt, then the butter. Press firmly into the tin and bake 18-20 min until deep golden. Leave the oven on.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Mash the cream cheese, zest and salt until creamy, whisk in the condensed milk until smooth, then the yolk. Gently whisk in the lime juice; it will thicken.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour over the base, smooth and bake 15-20 min, until set and just pulling from the sides (centre at least 71 °C).

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cool on a rack 1-1½ h, cover and refrigerate at least 2 h.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Lift out, cut into 16 and sprinkle with toasted coconut if using.

tips: Regular limes work fine if key limes are hard to find.
Let them stand 15 min out of the fridge before serving.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days.
